judgments.reason: Transcript consistently shows reports equal to the player's digit and the seal accepting them; there is no example or articulation of accepting an inflated (modulo seven congruent) report.
No amendments are used in the play transcript and the model text does not describe auditing vs credited-order mechanics, so the specified rule-order behavior is neither articulated nor demonstrated.

The transcript shows multiple players receiving 'Certificate paid 4' for serial S119 (evidence of duplication), but the model_articulation fails to state the underlying mechanism enabling repeated payments; because the model did not articulate the mechanism, both flags are set false per instructions.

No 'Ask the clerk' / receipt action is taken and the model text does not claim the clerk reveals inflated accepted reports; the transcript contains no evidence of this meta-rule being used or described.
